paper: DN-Splatter: Depth and Normal Priors for Gaussian Splatting and Meshing

mushroom_vr_room.source: Table 'Comparison of geometric supervision strategies' (tables/ab_our_supervision_strat.tex), MuSHRoom 'VR room', iPhone, 30k it. Split: within (test.txt, every-10th frame of the training sequence). The table does not state it, but every single-number MuSHRoom NVS table in the paper uses the within value (main_sfm_init 1M row 24.58/.8558 = Table 1 left; ab_2dgs_vs_dn_splatter_mono_sensor caption 'NVS is reported within the train sequence'). eval_mode='all' still averages within_/with_ separately (dn_pipeline.py:255-276, 499-545); a union is not an official metric. Baseline = vanilla ns-train splatfacto (eval/batch_run.py:186-207).

mushroom.source: Table main_table_NVS_mushroom (6-scene average only; left = every-10th frame of the training sequence, right = separate short_capture trajectory). Mesh Table main_table_mesh_mushroom: DN-Splatter C-L1 .0216 NC .8822 F1 .9243 (Splatfacto .0652/.7727/.5835).

scannetpp.source: Table main_table_mesh_scannetpp (b20a261fdf + 8b5caf3398, mesh only). ScanNet++ needs a licence agreement: not used.

tandt_courtroom_sparse_mono.source: supp. Table supp_sparse_mono (T&T advanced Courtroom, monocular depth; not locally available).

notes: No Mip-NeRF 360 / T&T truck-train / Deep Blending numbers. Baseline rows are Nerfstudio Splatfacto v1.1.3 retrained by the authors with the same 1M sensor-depth init. Metrics from Nerfstudio (torchmetrics PSNR/SSIM, LPIPS-AlexNet from torchmetrics on [0,1] inputs).
